thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Rapid drop in KV/prefix cache hit_rate for tenant MiraCloud (VPC: vpc-7, pool: dedicated-sg-7). hit_rate fell 78% -> 2% over 3m. Generation latency spike + increased 5xx. Pager routed to @oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. Paging SRE and eng-ml. Severity? If 5xx and user-visible, mark sev2 until contained. @customer-sre-miracloud can you confirm customer impact?

customer-sre-miracloud: Confirming large user-facing slowdowns, a subset of requests getting 503s. Bulk of traffic hitting prefixes under "miracloud/nsp/". We're getting reports from two customers saying timeouts after 10s.

sre-jordan: looking at cache dashboard now — there's a massive prefetch queue spike for prefixes starting with "miracloud/nsp/auto/". Prefetcher appears to be issuing aggressive population jobs; eviction rate spiked and caused cross-tenant eviction noise. I see eviction logs referencing tenant-ids not owned by MiraCloud (possible spillover).

eng-ml-sam: that aligns with the predictive prefetch rollout we started on dedicated pools yesterday (opt-in aggressive mode). If prefetch threads are unbounded they can evict other tenants' hot prefixes. Recommendation: disable prefetch for MiraCloud *immediately* and consider rolling back the aggressive rollout.

oncall-alex: Plan A (fast): disable prefetch for MiraCloud + evict the offending prefetch prefixes. Plan B (if still bad): route MiraCloud to fallback model variant and throttle their request concurrency. Tasks: @eng-ml-sam toggle flag, @sre-jordan run prefix inspect/evict, @infra-kat prepare traffic split to fallback. I'll coordinate customer comms.

sre-jordan: running quick counts now. Command I'm using:
```
# count prefixes for MiraCloud in pool sg-7
/opt/redwood/bin/cachectl --pool sg-7 --list-prefixes | grep "miracloud" | wc -l
```
And to evict aggressive prefetch prefix: 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/cachectl --pool sg-7 --evict-prefix "miracloud/nsp/auto-prefetch*" --force
```
Running count...

infra-kat: I can create a per-tenant traffic split. Will add 100% to model-lite-13B for MiraCloud as a temporary fallback while we stabilize. Making change in the console now, ETA ~4m.

eng-ml-sam: disabled prefetch for MiraCloud at 1826003400 via feature flag: `prefetch.enabled.tenants["MiraCloud"] = false`. Also initiated rollback of aggressive prefetch rollout for dedicated pools (global toggle).

customer-sre-miracloud: Noticing some improvement already in tail latency. Still seeing a few 5xx but much better than peak. Thanks.

sre-jordan: evict command completed — evicted 412 prefixes (mostly auto-prefetch entries). Post-eviction snapshot: cache hit_rate for MiraCloud up to ~61% from 2%, overall pool hit_rate trending up. Logs: 
```
[1826003455] evict: miracloud/nsp/auto-prefetch/12345 (size=18MB)
[1826003456] evict: miracloud/nsp/auto-prefetch/12346 (size=9MB)
...
[1826003462] evict complete (count=412)
```

oncall-alex: Great. Handing off monitoring and customer comms to @solutions-emily in ~25m. Please keep an eye on: post-eviction hit_rate, prefetch queue depth, and any residual cross-tenant evictions. I'll prepare incident timeline and notify account team. Severity => downgraded to sev3 for tracking, but remain open until a postmortem.

solutions-emily: taking over. Please paste runbook steps + commands used and any console screenshots. I'll open a customer-facing incident note and set expectations.

eng-ml-sam: follow-ups I'm filing: enforce per-tenant prefetch caps (max_concurrent_jobs), add prefetch queue depth alert (threshold 500 jobs), and add a hard-per-tenant memory cap for cache population to prevent eviction spillover. Ticket created: TKT-5279.

infra-kat: fallback routing applied at 1826003480. Traffic split 100% -> model-lite-13B for MiraCloud. Monitoring shows requests stabilizing.

customer-sre-miracloud: We pushed a non-critical config change on our side at ~1826003500 but it shouldn't have interacted with prefetch. Monitoring from customer side shows errors dropping. We'll keep support on standby.

sre-jordan: current metrics at 1826003550: MiraCloud hit_rate 67%, pool average 72%, eviction_rate back to baseline. No new cross-tenant eviction spikes.

oncall-alex: final notes before handoff: timeline of ops, commands ran, flags toggled, and who performed them. Create postmortem with root cause: aggressive predictive prefetch rollout + missing per-tenant caps -> prefetch spillover -> cache pollution -> hit-rate collapse -> latency/5xx. Action items: per-tenant caps, alerting, rollback checklist for prefetch, postmortem and customer RCA.

solutions-emily: ack. I'll send the customer-facing summary and schedule a follow-up call if they want a deep dive.

customer-sre-miracloud: Thanks team. Please include the list of evicted prefixes and the ETA for a permanent fix (we'd like per-tenant isolation hard guard).

oncall-alex: leaving detailed notes in the incident doc and assigning follow-up tickets. Handoff to @solutions-emily complete. Monitoring: continue for next 2 hours. Closing chat for now but will update thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
